subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should the per-agent database schema be deliberately advanced to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics as part of this refactor?
rationale: Repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances for explicit acceptance; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want this persistent upgrade commitment in the present journal migration.

options.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the v12 schema migration after reviewing redacted upgrade, restart, and doctor-import/archive evidence for an existing per-agent database.

options.title: Defer ACP persistence
options.body: Keep the non-session shared and plugin journal work separate and move ACP parent-stream persistence into a narrowly approved follow-up migration.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Explicitly accept the v12 schema migration after reviewing redacted upgrade, restart, and doctor-import/archive evidence for an existing per-agent database.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite flip establishes the directly adjacent per-agent schema and migration boundary.
